name: hud_ui_save_load_delete_button_on_activate
description: HudUiSaveLoadDeleteButton::OnActivate runs the base ZRD activation then asks its owner dialog to delete the selected save with confirmation.
known_limits: Local VC5 COFF target hud_ui_save_load_button_on_activate_cluster passes for 0x435140 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
